blocks.text: JOHOR BARU – Rising concerns over cyberattacks have prompted the Malaysian public to be on high alert and stay better informed about potential cybersecurity threats. Aisha Mohd Yusof, 39, said she was concerned about the growing number of cyberattacks worldwide, especially the possibility of disruptions to banking services and access to personal data. “However, I believe the Government will take the necessary steps to address such threats, including making announcements if there is a need for us to take certain measures to protect ourselves.
